findings.detail: Rows from the separate September 30, 2023 schedule of investments were retained in the December 31, 2023 holdings review population.

rationale: PP03 flags comparative-period position rows. The raw filing has distinct SOI sections for December 31, 2023 and September 30, 2023; the September 30 SOI totals to fair value 1,927,237 while the December 31 SOI totals to 2,857,808. Flagged position examples such as OneOncology First Lien Term Loan 2 are present in the September 30 block, so retaining those source-period rows under the December 31 report date is a real comparative-period leak.
